paper.title: Active Nonparametric Two-Sample Testing by Betting on Heterogeneous Data Sources

settings.name_in_paper: Active sequential nonparametric two-sample testing (ASN2T) over K heterogeneous data sources
unmapped: Each arm (source) k yields a paired sample (X_{k,1}, X_{k,2}) ~ P_{k,1} x P_{k,2}; goal is sequential test of global null H0: P_{k,1}=P_{k,2} for all k vs H1, a level-alpha power-one test minimizing expected stopping time
Arm 'informativeness' is the distance D_G^(k) = sup_{g in G} E[g(X_{k,1})-g(X_{k,2})] for a symmetric class G of functions into [-1/2,1/2]
Learner knows a lower bound L on the suboptimality gap r between best and second-best distance
settings.definition_quote: H_0:\forall\,k\in[K]\quad P_{k,1}=P_{k,2}, H_1:\exists k\in[K]\quad P_{k,1}\neq P_{k,2}. ... a level-$\alpha$ power-one sequential test should satisfy \mathbb{P}_{H_0}(\tau<\infty)\leq\alpha and \mathbb{P}_{H_1}(\tau<\infty)=1

algorithms.name: ASN2T test: vanishing epsilon(t)-greedy source selection with testing-by-betting (OGA prediction, ONS betting)

conditions: Assumption 3: G symmetric (g in G implies -g in G)
holds under the null H0, for any prediction/betting strategies and any selection policy

source.label: thm:main_thm
source.quote: Level-$\alpha$ property: Under Assumption~\ref{a:symmetric_G}, for any $\left\{\mathcal{A}^{(k)}_{\text{pred}}\right\}_{k\in[K]}$, $\mathcal{A}_{\text{bet}}$, and selection policy defined in Definition~\ref{def:ASN2T}, given a predefined accuracy $\alpha\in(0,1)$, \mathbb{P}_{H_0}(\tau^{(\text{ASN2T})}<\infty)\leq\alpha\quad\forall\,H_0.

results.notes: Type-I error (probability of ever stopping under the null). Power-one property (P_{H1}(tau<inf)=1 under a regret condition) from the same theorem not recorded as a numeric bound.

symbols.t_0: inf{t>=1: D_G^(a*) >= r_t + sigma_{a*} sqrt(log(t/alpha)/t) + log(t/alpha)/t}
symbols.sum_P_Ec: sum_t P(R_t^(a*)/t > r_t), summability of regret-deviation events of the prediction strategy on best source
symbols.T_explore: exploration cost, proportional to K and 1/L (shown O_tilde(K^3/L^6) in appendix)

conditions: Assumptions 1-3 (positive suboptimality gap r>0, some source distinguishable, symmetric G)
exists r_t -> 0 with sum_t P(E^c_{t,a*}) < infinity, E_{t,a*} = {R_t^(a*)/t <= r_t}

source.label: thm:main_thm
source.quote: Expected stopping time: Under Assumptions~\ref{a:positive_subopt_gap} to \ref{a:symmetric_G}, if there exists $\left\{r_{t}\right\}_{t\ge1}$ such that $r_t\rightarrow0$ and $\sum_{t\ge1}\mathbb{P}(E^c_{t,a^*})<\infty$ ... then \mathbb{E}_{H_1}[\tau^{(\text{ASN2T})}]\in O\left(t_0+\sum_{t\geq 1}\mathbb{P}(E^c_{t,a^*})+T_{\text{explore}}\right)

results.notes: Expected stopping time under the alternative recorded as sample_complexity.

symbols.tau_p: expected stopping time E[tau^(p)] of the passive single-source test of Shekhar & Ramdas using a suboptimal source
symbols.r_gap: suboptimality gap r between the best and second-best source distance D_G

conditions: passive test uses a suboptimal data source

source.label: co:comparison
source.quote: If the passive setting \cite{shekhar2025nonparametrictwosampletestingbetting} uses a sub-optimal data source and $\sigma_{a^*}^2\leq\max_{k\neq a^*}\sigma_{k}^2$, then \mathbb{E}_{H_1}[\tau^{\text{ASN2T}}]\leq\mathbb{E}_{H_1}[\tau^{(p)}]+O\left(\frac{K^2}{r^2}(\log(1/\alpha))^{2/3}\right) ... Asymptotically, \lim_{\alpha\rightarrow0}\frac{\mathbb{E}[\tau^{\text{ASN2T}}]}{\log(1/\alpha)}\leq\lim_{\alpha\rightarrow0}\frac{\mathbb{E}[\tau^{(p)}]}{\log(1/\alpha)}.

results.notes: Only the additive O term is in O-notation; E[tau^(p)] appears exactly. Asymptotic ratio comparison as alpha->0 also stated, not recorded separately.
